blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Filipino was among those injured in a deadly train collision in Spain that killed at least 68 people, the Philippine Embassy in Madrid confirmed on Wednesday. The embassy said the Filipino sustained minor injuries and was brought to a hospital for medical attention. “As of this time, we have verified information of one (1) Filipino national who sustained minor injury and was brought to a hospital for medical attention,” the embassy said in a statement. READ: Spain train collision kills 31, injures 80, says regional gov’t The embassy did not disclose the Filipino’s identity or current condition. […]...
